recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見許多核呈卵圓或摺疊、染色質淡的大型細胞（組織球樣）夾雜紅血球母細胞、嗜酸性球與出血，偶見分裂相；巨大顆粒在 H&E 切片中無法確認。
features: Numerous large cells with oval to folded vesicular nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (histiocyte-like)
Admixed erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and scattered eosinophils
Interstitial hemorrhage with extravasated red cells
Giant granules not discernible on H&E
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow with a mixed infiltrate. Many large cells have oval, folded or indented vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, suggestive of histiocytes, admixed with erythroid precursors, eosinophils, lymphocytes and occasional mitoses in a hemorrhagic background. Cytoplasmic giant granules cannot be resolved on this section. In the context of Chediak-Higashi syndrome, the histiocyte-rich infiltrate raises concern for the accelerated (HLH-like) phase; CD163/CD68 IHC and aspirate correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; absence of giant granules on aspirate plus genetic testing (PRF1, UNC13D, STX11) favors familial HLH over CHS.
LCH cells have grooved coffee-bean nuclei with CD1a/langerin positivity and eosinophil-rich clusters.
Lymphoma cells are cytologically atypical and express B- or T-cell markers rather than CD163.
